name: dev
description: Provides development workflows, PR-writing guidance, code-craft preferences, runtime verification, and the bare `dev` dispatcher for Grove-backed projects — routes `dev grove …` to grove, repo-defined `.dev/<branch>` executables, and everything else to `grove dev`; `crtr dev` is a native extensible branch for repository-generated command fragments, with `crtr dev grove …` forwarded to Grove.

requires.grove: Install Grove, then run `grove setup` in the source repository.

spec/requirements.whenToUse: Derive testable EARS requirements from a finished, approved design — in isolation, from the rendered design text alone.
